requests.expected_review_body: Some tags aren't removed correctly when the file is saved. When the X next to URL is pressed, for example, saving doesn't actually retain the change.
requests.expected_current_reply: Thank you for reporting this issue! We’ve fixed the problem where changes to URL and other tags weren’t retained after saving. The fix is included in version 2.5.6. Please try it once the update is available, and let us know if you still experience any issues.
requests.replacement_reply: Thank you for reporting this issue! We've fixed the problem where changes to URL and other tags weren't retained after saving.
